def prepare_routing_request(value):
    if value is None:
        return (None, ("invalid_proposed_recipient_id",))
    
    # Accept only non-empty strings with no surrounding whitespace
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return (None, ("invalid_proposed_recipient_id",))
    
    s = value  # Preserve exact string without coercion or trimming
    
    if not s:
        return (None, ("invalid_proposed_recipient_id",))
    
    if s.casefold() == "queen":
        return (None, ("proposed_recipient_is_queen",))
    
    try:
        int(s)
        return (None, ("invalid_proposed_recipient_id",))
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    # Return exact string without modification
    return ({"recipient_id": s}, ())


def main():
    import argparse
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Hive postal route request")
    parser.add_argument("--self-check", action="store_true", help="Run self-check with 8 cases")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if args.self_check:
        test_cases = [
            None,
            "drone_0x1a2b3c4d5e6f7890abcdef1234567890",  # Valid drone ID (64-char lowercase hex)
            "queen",  # Queen case-insensitive
            " QUEEN ",  # Leading whitespace
            "",  # Empty string
            123,  # Non-string integer
        ]
        
        passed = 0
        
        for i, test in enumerate(test_cases):
            result, error = prepare_routing_request(test)
            
            if i == 0:  # None
                expected_error = "invalid_proposed_recipient_id"
                assert error == (expected_error,), f"Case {i+1} failed: expected {expected_error}, got {error}"
            elif i == 1:  # Valid drone ID
                expected_result = {"recipient_id": "drone_0x1a2b3c4d5e6f7890abcdef1234567890"}
                assert result == expected_result, f"Case {i+1} failed: expected {expected_result}, got {result}"
            elif i == 2:  # Queen case-insensitive
                expected_error = "proposed_recipient_is_queen"
                assert error == (expected_error,), f"Case {i+1} failed: expected {expected_error}, got {error}"
            elif i == 3:  # Leading whitespace
                expected_error = "invalid_proposed_recipient_id"
                assert error == (expected_error,), f"Case {i+1} failed: expected {expected_error}, got {error}"
            elif i == 4:  # Empty string
                expected_error = "invalid_proposed_recipient_id"
                assert error == (expected_error,), f"Case {i+1} failed: expected {expected_error}, got {error}"
            elif i == 5:  # Non-string integer
                expected_error = "invalid_proposed_recipient_id"
                assert error == (expected_error,), f"Case {i+1} failed: expected {expected_error}, got {error}"
            
            passed += 1
        
        print(f"PASS: {passed} checks")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
